## Homework

Working in pairs, students will complete the following tasks:

- Delineate five 1-hectare polygons across campus using the 2025 Bogotá orthoimage.
- Collect field waypoints for the same polygons using a GNSS receiver.
- Replicate the QGIS practical exercise using their own campus data.
- Compare the digitized area against the field-measured area.
🎥 

Final Assessment:
Students will document their findings in a technical report, which will serve as the Examen Final. This report is due on *November 26*.

## 📚 Recommended Reading 

Study [How GNSS works](https://www.geospatialworld.net/blogs/how-gnss-works/).
